arguments.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS organizer_awards,
    COUNT(DISTINCT organizer.UserId) AS organizer_users,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.Location) AS distinct_locations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS germany_mentions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN u.Location LIKE '%Deutschland%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deutschland_mentions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN u.Location IS NULL OR TRIM(u.Location) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_locations,
    MIN(organizer.Date) AS first_timestamp,
    MAX(organizer.Date) AS last_timestamp
FROM badges AS organizer
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = organizer.UserId
WHERE organizer.Name = 'Organizer'

SELECT u.Location, organizer.Date,
       COUNT(earlier.Id) AS prior_badges,
       COUNT(DISTINCT earlier.Name) AS prior_badge_names
FROM badges AS organizer
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = organizer.UserId
LEFT JOIN badges AS earlier
    ON earlier.UserId = organizer.UserId
   AND earlier.Date < organizer.Date
WHERE organizer.Name = 'Organizer'
  AND (u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' OR u.Location IN ('Munich', 'Minga'))
GROUP BY organizer.Id
ORDER BY u.Location, prior_badges
LIMIT 50

arguments.sql:
WITH organizer_awards AS (
    SELECT b.UserId, MIN(b.Date) AS organizer_date
    FROM badges AS b
    JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
    WHERE b.Name = 'Organizer'
      AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
    GROUP BY b.UserId
),
qualified_users AS (
    SELECT o.UserId
    FROM organizer_awards AS o
    JOIN badges AS b
      ON b.UserId = o.UserId
     AND b.Date < o.organizer_date
    GROUP BY o.UserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 5
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM qualified_users
LIMIT 1
